messages:
kevin_procurement: FYI vendor just sent an update — 3 week lead time bump on the EU H100 allocation (200 units). They offered split shipments and an RMA pickup window for any DOAs. asking for direction on expedite fees and customs handling.

maria_ops: ugh. which warehouses are impacted? do we have enough on-prem capacity to borrow from other regions? :thinking_face:

kevin_procurement: EU pool affected: FRA and AMS staging. We had planned to route 120 -> FRA, 80 -> AMS. Vendor says they can air 50 immediately, rest sea/air split over 3 weeks. No firm ETA on AWBs yet.

tara_logistics: we should force a single forwarder for split shipments to avoid multiple customs runs. I'll ping our forwarder to get provisional AWB rates and whether they can consolidate at origin.

sam_sre: cluster impact: with 3-week delay at full scale, we hit 12% capacity shortfall on inference pools in eu-west-1 during peak. Short-term mitigation: reduce preview batch sizes and enable KV cache warmup endpoints. I'll put a config to throttle non-prod jobs.

maria_ops: can we pull 40 GPUs from US spare pool temporarily? what's the transport timeline?

kevin_procurement: asked vendor for a one-time loaner program — they said possible but +$1200/unit expedite fee. asked for waiver. also asked to include RMA pickup for DOAs at no extra cost.

forwarder_bot: Quote attached: https://shipping.example/quote/ZX-9182 — air unit cost + customs brokerage estimate + ETA variance. (doc id: ZX-9182)

kevin_procurement: vendor replied — willing to waive expedite fee if we accept 2x split shipments and cover customs brokerage. They want commit to the full PO or they reassign units.

tara_logistics: cover brokerage (ok) but not extra handling fees. I'll negotiate consolidation and get a provisional AWB schedule. If we can get vendor to pre-clear export docs, customs time drops ~24h.

sam_sre: ok on config changes. also recommend we mark two nodes per cluster as degraded-friendly to avoid noisy retries. I'll open a monitoring alert for GPU saturations and set slack ping to #eng-sre.

maria_ops: action items: (1) tara negotiate AWB consolidation + waive extra handling, (2) kevin push vendor loaner or waive expedite, (3) sam toggle throttle + alerts, (4) ops to draft rollback plan if DOA rate >3%.

kevin_procurement: creating ticket — https://redwood.internal/t/PROV-4872 — put updates in that ticket and paste AWBs when available. tagging @tara_logistics @maria_ops @sam_sre :thumbsup:

tara_logistics: on it. pinging forwarder and customs broker now. will update ETA by EOD. :phone:
